answer: Admission opens only at epoch dawn, via a public VRF lottery that issues a hard cap of tickets per funding cluster, not per key. Aliases that share a payer collapse into one ticket, so a farm cannot blanket the field. Between draws the protocol keeps a tundra of probationary seats with near-zero voting weight; influence may rise toward a published zenith only after several independently attested jobs from already-separated counterparties. Unused dawn tickets expire, and a later cluster proof slashes the ticket bond, making extra keypairs a cost rather than a vote multiplier.
